description: A long narrow shop with a cutting table down the middle, bolts of cloth along one wall and a curtained fitting cubicle at the back. Two sewing machines sit under the window. The old chip counter has a cloth over it now, and finished jackets hang on a rail by the door. The street is east.

window.description: The shop window, clean now, with the back of the dummy in it. Past its shoulder is Ironside Street and whoever is walking past, mostly looking at the jacket.
window.name: the shop window

name: Alter Ego
ambient_events: The electric machine runs a seam in one long burst and stops.
Shears go through cloth on the cutting table in three clean bites.
The steam iron hisses on its rest.
Somebody behind the fitting curtain says it is fine, it is fine, it is a bit tight.
